help.title: Help
help.q1_question: How do I request a ride?
help.q1_answer: Open the app, enter your destination, choose the vehicle type, and confirm. A driver will be assigned in minutes.
help.q2_answer: We accept cash (CUP) and TriciCoin trip credits. You can buy credits with a card and choose your preferred method in your profile.
help.q3_question: How do I cancel a ride?
help.q3_answer: You can cancel a ride before the driver arrives at the pickup point. A cancellation fee may apply if the driver is already on the way.
help.q4_answer: TriciCoin is TriciGo's prepaid trip credit. You can earn it through referrals, promotions, and quests, and it's used only to pay for rides within the app. It's not money or a currency, and it cannot be converted to cash.
help.q5_question: How do I contact my driver?
help.q5_answer: Once the driver is assigned, you can call or message them directly from the app.
help.q6_question: What do I do if I left something in the vehicle?
help.q6_answer: Go to your ride history, select the ride, and use the "Lost item report" option. We'll connect you with the driver.
help.q7_question: How does the SOS button work?
help.q7_answer: During a ride, you can press the SOS button to alert your trusted contacts and share your location in real time.
help.contact_desc: Our support team is available to help you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_text: TriciGo ("we", "our") operates the TriciGo mobile application and website. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our transportation services.
privacy.controller_text: The controller of your personal data is MACH DIGITAL TECH S.R.L., a company incorporated in Brașov, Romania. For any data protection inquiries, you may contact our data protection contact at soporte@tricigo.com.
privacy.legal_basis_text: We process your personal data in accordance with Article 6 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The applicable legal bases are: performance of the service contract between you and us; our legitimate interest in ensuring platform security and preventing fraud; and your consent, where it is required for a specific processing activity.
privacy.data_collected_intro: We collect the following information to provide you with the service:
privacy.data_name_phone: Full name and phone number (account registration)
privacy.data_location: Real-time location (only during active app use to connect you with nearby drivers)
privacy.data_ride_history: Ride history (origin, destination, fare, date and time)
privacy.data_payment: Payment information (TriciCoin trip credit balance, transactions)
privacy.data_device: Device information (model, operating system, push notification token)
privacy.data_use_intro: We use your information exclusively to:
privacy.use_provide_service: Connect you with drivers and manage your rides
privacy.use_improve: Improve service quality and user experience
privacy.use_safety: Ensure the safety of passengers and drivers
privacy.use_communications: Send you notifications about your rides and service updates
privacy.sharing_text: We share your name and location with the driver assigned to your ride so they can pick you up. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for commercial purposes. We may share anonymized data for statistical purposes.
privacy.processors_text: We rely on providers that process personal data on TriciGo's behalf, under contractual instructions: Supabase (backend and database), Stripe (payment processing), Mapbox (mapping services), Sentry (error logging), and PostHog (analytics, hosted in the EU region). Some of these providers may involve international data transfers, which are always subject to adequate safeguards under the GDPR.
privacy.retention_text: We retain your personal information as long as your account remains active. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us. Ride history is retained for a minimum of 1 year for legal and safety requirements.
privacy.right_deletion: Request deletion of your account and data
privacy.right_portability: Request a copy of your data in a portable format
privacy.authority_text: The competent supervisory authority is the ANSPDCP (Autoritatea Națională de Supraveghere a Prelucrării Datelor cu Caracter Personal), Romania's national data protection authority. If you believe the processing of your personal data infringes applicable law, you have the right to lodge a complaint with it.
privacy.security_text: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your information, including encryption in transit (TLS/SSL), secure authentication, and restricted access to personal data. However, no system is 100% secure.
privacy.children_text: TriciGo is not directed at children under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect information from minors. If we discover we have collected data from a minor, we will promptly delete it.
privacy.changes_text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the application or other means. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes your acceptance.
privacy.contact_text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, contact us:

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Service
terms.acceptance_text: By downloading, installing, or using the TriciGo application, you agree to these Terms and Conditions of Service. If you disagree, do not use the service. TriciGo reserves the right to modify these terms with prior notice.
terms.service_desc_text: TriciGo is a technology platform that connects passengers with independent drivers of triciclos, motorcycles, and cars in Cuba. TriciGo is not a transportation company; it acts as a technology intermediary facilitating connections between users and drivers.
terms.eligibility_text: To use TriciGo you must be at least 18 years old, have a valid mobile phone number in Cuba, and provide accurate information when registering. Drivers must meet additional documentation and verification requirements.
terms.accounts_text: Each user must create an account with a valid phone number. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and all activities conducted under it. You must not share your account with third parties. TriciGo may suspend or cancel accounts that violate these terms.
terms.rides_text: When requesting a ride, you will receive a fare estimate that may vary based on actual distance, time, and demand conditions (surge pricing). The final fare is agreed upon between passenger and driver. TriciGo charges a service commission on each completed ride.
terms.payments_text: Payments can be made in cash (CUP) or with TriciCoin trip credits. TriciCoin credits are prepaid trip credit, redeemable solely for TriciGo transportation services — see the section 'Nature of TriciCoin Credits'. Fares are displayed in local currency (CUP).
terms.tricicoin_nature_text: TriciCoin credits are internal prepaid balance, redeemable exclusively for transportation services within the TriciGo platform. They do not constitute money, currency, electronic money (e-money), or a payment instrument; they are not convertible to cash and do not represent a payment or bank account. They may be sent as a gift to another registered TriciGo user via the «Gift» feature, retaining their closed-loop transport-credit nature: gifted balance can only be used to pay for rides within the platform and is not redeemable for money. Credits are purchased in advance and are consumed when paying for rides.
terms.aml_text: TriciCoin credits may only be used to pay for rides within the TriciGo platform. Each top-up is subject to limits: a minimum of 20 USD and a maximum of 500 USD per transaction. We monitor anomalous usage patterns and reserve the right to suspend an account upon any indication of misuse or fraudulent use of credits.
terms.pci_text: Card payment processing is carried out through a payment provider certified under the PCI-DSS Level 1 standard. MACH DIGITAL TECH S.R.L. does not store card data on its systems; its payment environment qualifies as PCI-DSS SAQ-A.
terms.descriptor_text: Charges related to your top-ups will appear on your card statement with the description "TRICIGO MOBILITY RO".
terms.cancellations_text: You may cancel a ride before the driver arrives at the pickup point. Frequent or late cancellations may result in temporary restrictions on your account. Drivers may also cancel rides under justified circumstances.
terms.conduct_respectful: Treat drivers and passengers with respect and courtesy
terms.conduct_laws: Comply with all applicable local laws and regulations
terms.conduct_no_fraud: Not engage in fraudulent activities or manipulate the referral or promotions system
terms.conduct_no_damage: Not cause damage to vehicles or other users' belongings
terms.liability_text: TriciGo facilitates connections between passengers and drivers but is not directly responsible for transportation. We do not guarantee permanent service availability. Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the service in question. We are not responsible for lost items, although we will facilitate communication between parties.
terms.ip_text: The TriciGo application, its design, logo, name, and content are property of TriciGo. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works without written authorization.
terms.termination_text: TriciGo may suspend or terminate your access to the service at any time if you violate these terms, engage in fraudulent activities, or endanger other users' safety. You may delete your account at any time from the app settings.
terms.modifications_text: TriciGo may modify, suspend, or discontinue any aspect of the service at any time. We will notify you of significant changes with reasonable advance notice.
terms.governing_law_text: These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with Romanian law. Any dispute arising from the use of the TriciGo platform shall be submitted to the competent courts of Brașov, Romania, without prejudice to a consumer user's right to bring proceedings before the courts of their place of habitual residence under applicable consumer-protection law. These terms do not affect the mandatory rights granted to the user under the law of their country of residence. The transport service is provided by independent drivers and is physically carried out in Cuba, where it is subject to the transport and traffic regulations applicable in Cuba. The contractual relationship between the user and MACH DIGITAL TECH S.R.L. —including the platform, TriciCoin credits, and these Terms— is governed by Romanian law as set out above; Cuban transport legislation governs the actual provision of the ride, not the contractual relationship with the platform.
